## Activity

During December 2018, North City Eye Clinic recorded 470 captures. This section reports the activity completed during the month and provides the total number of captures used for the image-quality and grading measures below. The capture total is presented as the monthly activity figure for the site.

The reported activity was 470 captures for December 2018. This provides the denominator for considering the number of images that could not be graded and the associated ungradable rate.

## Image quality

Of the 470 captures, 10 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1 per cent. These figures show the number and proportion of captures for which the image quality did not support grading. The image-quality result is reported separately from the grading outcome.

## Grading

Grading identified 73 referable results from the activity recorded at North City Eye Clinic in December 2018. The median lag from image capture to grading was 8 days. This is the midpoint measure for the interval between capture and completion of grading. Together, the referable total and median lag summarise the grading output and timeliness for the month.
